title: Low-Sodium, Veggie-Rich Week for One
summary: This week uses your Thermomix TM7 to steam fish, poultry, and fresh vegetables while cooking whole grains and pulses with salt-free herbs, lemon, and garlic instead of added salt. Cooking extra portions at dinner four nights a week gives you ready-made lunches and keeps daily meals simple, balanced, and portioned for one.

recipes.title: Warm Quinoa, Chickpea and Spinach Bowl with Lemon-Herb Dressing

ingredients.name: quinoa
ingredients.note: rinsed thoroughly under cold running water

steps.text: Place 1000 g of water into the mixing bowl. Insert the simmering basket and weigh in 70 g of rinsed quinoa. Place the Varoma dish into position, add 120 g of drained chickpeas and 100 g of halved cherry tomatoes into the Varoma dish, cover with the Varoma lid, and steam
steps.then: Carefully remove the Varoma lid away from your face to avoid escaping steam.

steps.text: Add 80 g of baby spinach to the Varoma dish on top of the chickpeas and tomatoes, replace the Varoma lid, and steam
steps.then: Set the Varoma aside. Use the notch on the spatula to lift out the simmering basket, transfer the cooked quinoa, chickpeas, tomatoes, and spinach to a serving bowl, and empty the mixing bowl.

steps.text: Place 10 g of extra-virgin olive oil, 15 g of fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp of salt-free mixed dried herbs, and 1 pinch of black pepper into the empty mixing bowl, mix
steps.then: Pour the lemon-herb dressing over the warm quinoa and vegetable bowl, toss gently with the spatula, and serve immediately.

tips: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly in a fine-mesh sieve before cooking to remove its natural bitter coating (saponin).
Leave a few steam vents unobstructed in the bottom of the Varoma dish so the steam circulates evenly around the chickpeas and spinach.
recipes.why: Made with whole-grain quinoa, no-salt-added chickpeas, baby spinach, and cherry tomatoes, and seasoned with lemon juice and salt-free herbs instead of added salt.
recipes.evidence: For adults, the World Health Organization recommends consuming less than 2000 mg of sodium per day, which is equivalent to less than 5 grams of salt [WHO — Sodium reduction (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Steamed Salmon with Broccoli, Carrots and Brown Rice

steps.text: Place 1200 g of water into the mixing bowl. Insert the simmering basket, weigh in 140 g of brown rice, close the mixing bowl lid, and cook
steps.then: Meanwhile, arrange 250 g of broccoli florets and 160 g of sliced carrots in the Varoma dish, leaving a few vents uncovered for steam to pass through.

steps.text: Line the Varoma tray with a sheet of wetted, crumpled baking paper, keeping the side vents clear. Place 280 g of salmon fillets on the tray and sprinkle with 1 tsp of salt-free mixed dried herbs and 1 pinch of black pepper. Set the Varoma dish and tray in position, cover with the Varoma lid, and steam
steps.then: Check that the salmon flakes easily in the centre and the vegetables and brown rice are tender.

steps.text: Remove the Varoma and lift out the simmering basket using the notch on the spatula. Divide the brown rice, steamed broccoli, carrots, and salmon between two portions: plate one serving now and drizzle with 5 g of extra-virgin olive oil and 15 g of lemon juice; pack the second portion with the remaining 5 g of extra-virgin olive oil and 15 g of lemon juice in an airtight container for the next meal.
steps.then: Cool the leftover portion promptly and store it in the refrigerator.

tips: Wetting and crumpling the baking paper helps it fit snugly on the Varoma tray while keeping the side vents free for steam circulation.
Store the leftover portion in a sealed container in the refrigerator and enjoy it chilled as a salmon rice bowl or gently reheat it.
recipes.why: Steamed salmon fillets, broccoli, carrots, and whole-grain brown rice cooked without added salt and dressed with extra-virgin olive oil, herbs, and fresh lemon.
recipes.evidence: Everyone older than 10 years of age should aim for at least 400 grams of fruits and vegetables per day and at least 25 grams of naturally-occurring dietary fibre from foods [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Herbed Chicken Breast with Zucchini, Bell Peppers and Quinoa

steps.text: Pour 1200 g water into the mixing bowl. Insert the simmering basket and weigh in 140 g rinsed quinoa.
Arrange 250 g zucchini half-moons and 200 g bell pepper strips in the Varoma dish, leaving some holes unobstructed for steam to circulate.

Line the Varoma tray with wet, crumpled baking paper, keeping the side vents uncovered. Toss 300 g chicken breast strips with 2 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs and 2 pinches black pepper, then spread them across the tray. Fit the Varoma into position and steam
steps.then: Check that the chicken is cooked through and the quinoa is tender.

steps.text: Remove the Varoma and use the spatula notch to lift out the simmering basket. Divide the quinoa, steamed vegetables, and herbed chicken into two equal portions.

Dress both portions with the juice of 1 lemon and 2 tsp extra-virgin olive oil. Serve one portion warm now, and pack the second portion into an airtight container and refrigerate once cooled for the next meal.

tips: Wetting and crumpling the baking paper makes it mould easily to the Varoma tray while keeping the chicken juices from dripping onto the vegetables below.
recipes.why: Steamed lean chicken breast, quinoa, zucchini, and bell peppers seasoned with salt-free dried herbs and lemon juice.

recipes.title: Hearty Red Lentil, Carrot and Spinach Stew

steps.text: Place 100 g of halved yellow onions, 2 cloves of garlic, and 200 g of carrot pieces in the mixing bowl, chop
steps.then: Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl with the spatula.

steps.text: Add 10 g of extra-virgin olive oil to the mixing bowl, sauté
Add 160 g of rinsed dried lentils, 600 g of low-sodium vegetable stock, 1 tsp of salt-free mixed dried herbs, and 1 pinch of black pepper to the mixing bowl, cook
Add 120 g of baby spinach to the mixing bowl, push down gently with the spatula, and cook until wilted
Stir in the juice of 0.5 lemon with the spatula. Serve half of the stew warm now, and transfer the remaining portion to an airtight container to cool and refrigerate for the next meal.

tips: Lentils naturally thicken as they cool; add a splash of water or low-sodium stock when reheating the leftover portion.
recipes.why: Built around pulses and fresh vegetables like carrots, onion, and spinach, this stew relies on garlic, salt-free herbs, and lemon juice instead of added salt.
recipes.evidence: Everyone older than 10 years of age should aim for at least 400 grams of fruits and vegetables per day and at least 25 grams of naturally-occurring dietary fibre from foods such as pulses, vegetables, and whole grains [WHO — Healthy diet (fact sheet)].

recipes.title: Steamed Eggs with Spinach, Cherry Tomatoes and Avocado Toast

ingredients.name: avocado
ingredients.note: half a fruit, peeled and pitted

steps.text: Pour 500 g water into the mixing bowl. Place the 2 eggs in the Varoma dish, set the Varoma in position and steam
steps.then: Carefully remove the Varoma lid away from the face to let the steam escape.

steps.text: Insert the Varoma tray with 150 g halved cherry tomatoes and 60 g baby spinach, cover and steam
steps.then: Remove the Varoma and rinse the eggs under cold water to peel easily.

steps.text: Meanwhile, mash 75 g avocado in a small bowl with 15 ml lemon juice, 1 tsp salt-free mixed dried herbs, and a pinch of black pepper.
